content:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: PROD alert: prompt-router-v2 error rate up since 1851234500. 5xx jump ~18% (baseline 0.4%), tail latency p99 -> 4.2s. Canary at 20% traffic. Auto-rollback did not trigger (errors are from routing mismatch).
pagerduty-bot: Paging oncall (pagetyping: high-sev).
sasha: seeing same in dashboards, stacktrace points at router::route_batch failing on new endpoint path_prefix '/exp/v2'.
liam: tagging @oncall-next — are you on it?
oncall-next: oncall-next here, acked. Pulling logs and tracing. Any customer reports?
maya: receiving slack DMs from big-ecom and analytics-prod customers with failed completions & timeouts. They're seeing 502s.
ben: diggin into deploy logs — the rollout added a header check for X-Routing-Variant that our legacy proxy doesn't set. mismatch causes 500 in handler.
sasha: good find. we can either rollback deployment or flip feature flag for routing to force fallback. prefer FF flip to avoid full deploy.
liam: agree. Which flag? name?
sasha: flag is exp_prompt_route_v2. scope: prod, 20% slice.
oncall-next: can someone flip it? I don't have console perms.
ops-bot: ops runbook: to disable: `rdctl feature toggle set exp_prompt_route_v2 false --env=prod` or via Console -> Feature Flags -> exp_prompt_route_v2 -> Off. Audit will record operator.
ben: I can run rdctl from bastion. prepping command.
ben: running: `rdctl feature toggle set exp_prompt_route_v2 false --env=prod --actor=ben.t`
ops-bot: acknowledged. Change committing, will take ~10s to propagate to all edge routers.
sasha: switching metrics to 1m window and watching 5xx rate.
liam: notifying support to tell affected customers we have mitigation in progress.
ben: flag disabled at 1851234678.
oncall-next: confirmed — traffic now hitting legacy route; error rate dropping. p50/p95 latencies stable.
maya: big-ecom confirms reduced errors, they report fewer timeouts.
sasha: digging post-change logs: new endpoint requests dropped from 22rps to 0. New route fallback working.
liam: good. can we keep flag off until we patch header handling and add proxy compatibility?
ben: yes. I'll open PR to check proxy header before routing. estimate fix + test = 3-4 hrs.
oncall-next: creating incident page and tagging SRE for follow-up, assigning to ben for fix and sasha for rollout plan.
sasha: also add a unit test & integration test for route header present/absent.
liam: customer comm: support draft prepared, will send post-mitigation summary and ETA for full fix.
ops-bot: reminder: create postmortem ticket, link incident timeline, include exec summary and impact table (customers affected, seconds of error, mitigation steps).
oncall-next: closing on-call window; handoff to next rotation for monitoring. If errors reappear, page oncall-next again.
ben: will push fix to a canary with zero-impact tests and then re-run a staged rollout.
sasha: thanks everyone. keep this thread for status updates until postmortem created. :thumbsup:
